mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can cause systemic absorption leading to potential additive effects with quinidine's cardiac and hypotensive properties, plus quinidine may inhibit metabolism of brimonidine metabolites.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely; consider alternative alpha-2 agonist or quinidine if clinically feasible, and counsel patient on systemic absorption precautions with ophthalmic brimonidine.
